programme.title: S1E2 The Jackson Goldstone Story
programme.desc: Beyond Limits: The Jackson Goldstone Story is an electrifying YouTube series that follows mountain biking sensation Jackson Goldstone through his 2023 UCI Downhill World Championship season. Watch as he pushes his limits on some of the most dangerous downhill courses in the world, from steep, rocky descents to twisting forest trails, attacking every challenge with unmatched skill and determination. Go behind the scenes to see the intense training sessions, precise bike tuning, and mental preparation that fuel his success. Experience the rush of high-stakes racing with heart-pounding runs, fierce rivalries, and moments that will keep you holding your breath. More than just the action, Beyond Limits reveals Jackson’s personal journey, the sacrifices he makes for his passion, and the powerful support network that drives him forward. This is the ultimate inside look at a world-class athlete chasing glory on two wheels.

Watch as he pushes his limits on some of the most dangerous downhill courses in the world, from steep, rocky descents to twisting forest trails, attacking every challenge with unmatched skill and determination. Go behind the scenes to see the intense training sessions, precise bike tuning, and mental preparation that fuel his success. Experience the rush of high-stakes racing with heart-pounding runs, fierce rivalries, and moments that will keep you holding your breath. More than just the action, Beyond Limits reveals Jackson’s personal journey, the sacrifices he makes for his passion, and the powerful support network that drives him forward. This is the ultimate inside look at a world-class athlete chasing glory on two wheels.

programme.title: Catching Bass | River Bass

programme.title: FishON! | Trailblazing to Trophy Walleye: Polaris Ranger Adventure
programme.desc: Join the FishON! TV crew as we tackle rugged Northern Ontario terrain with our Polaris Ranger equipped with a custom boat rack. This remote expedition takes us deep into the wilderness to an untouched lake known for its walleye bounty. From the adrenaline of the journey to the thrill of the catch, this episode is packed with adventure, stunning scenery, and fishing tips you won’t want to miss!

programme.title: Stoked on Fishing | Party Boat El Dorado Takes on Cortez Bank
programme.desc: Fishing out west has been fantastic this year, but eventually, the fish move or disappear due to currents, weather, or heavy traffic. However, there are always some offshore banks that have resident fish on or around them year-round, and one of those spots is called the Cortez Bank. You can always guarantee one thing: if you make it 110 miles, you'll catch some big Rockfish. Additionally, if Mother Nature and currents work out in your favor, there can be some incredible Yellowtail fishing on the bank. Today, we're rallying up for our "Stoked On Fishing" day and a half charter on board the one and only El Dorado, a top vessel in the Long Beach sport fishing scene. With anticipation running high, we can't wait to cast our lines and see what kind of adventures await us on the open waters.

programme.title: AmeriCarna - DRAGSTER DIPLOMACY
programme.desc: In 1964, the United States sent a star-studded race team to England to educate them on drag racing. On that team was Bob Keith and his Dos Palmas car. After being lost for over 40 years, Ray uncovers car and puts together a plan to reunite the two once more. The restoration of the car takes an emotional turn with the loss of a friend.

programme.title: AmeriCarna - BOARD TRACK BATTLES

programme.title: AmeriCarna - MODEL T

programme.title: Boom America
programme.desc: Boom America is kicking off with a bang, led by the legendary shark himself, Kevin Harrington. Backed by his team of successful entrepreneurs, Kevin meets with businesses to jumpstart their success and take them to a whole new level. From Nuethix, a supplement line struggling with client acquisition and education, to Stream2Sea, a eco-friendly sunscreen wanting to become a household name—Kevin and the A-team are ready to jump in and get their hands dirty.

programme.title: Boom America
programme.desc: It’s time to go to work. Now that we’ve met our companies, Kevin and the A-team are ready to hit the ground running. NuEhtix, Dr Price Vitamins, Stream2Sea and Clear Water get a deep dive round table session from Kevin and His A-team. We also get to meet the A-Team players and what make them titans in their trades. Tune in to see the insights the team come up with and how the companies apply it to build their brands.

programme.title: Boom America
programme.desc: This week is all about health and wellness. Kyle Reyes is back with Nuethix for an inspection into the inner workings of their company.. and his health. Then, the team gets a closer look at Dr. Price’s chiropractor practice and his unique start to the vitamin operations game. Then, get your questions about Clear Water quenched as we take a deeper dive into the company and their global legacy. To cap off the episode, two A-Team members head over to check out Stream2Sea’s innovative factory.

programme.title: Farm Hero
programme.desc: The rain simulator is up and running and the results are shocking. But where do we go from here? How do we fix what’s broken and return to farming with Mother Nature and not against it? Wayne Swanson in Chattanooga Tennessee has some answers. This special episode of Farm Hero highlights the important mission American farmers are on tackling to protect and revitalize our soil… with the help of some Swiss Army Bugs.

programme.title: Farm Hero
programme.desc: In part one of the season finale, Laura is immersing herself in all the wonders that are TomKat ranch. Created by Kat Taylor and Tom Steyer, TomKat ranch is part ranch, part laboratory, part educational facility and all around the American Dream. This ranch is doing their part at spear-heading the rural revitalization that will bring about climate stability and a healthier planet.

programme.title: Monster's Ball
programme.desc: Hank, an embittered racist prison guard working on death row, begins an unlikely, emotionally charged sexual relationship with Leticia, a Black woman and wife of a man sentenced to death. The affair begins just after Hank oversees the capital punishment of Leticia's husband.

programme.title: Set Up
programme.desc: With help from a gangster, a betrayed man (Curtis "50 Cent" Jackson) seeks revenge for a heist gone wrong.

programme.title: To Live and Die and Live
programme.desc: A filmmaker returns to Detroit to bury his stepfather and settle his accounts, but his struggles with addiction and loss may finish him before he finishes the task.

programme.title: Uninvited Guest
programme.desc: A screenwriter, his neglected wife and their guests become the prey of a deadly stranger who arrives on their doorstep.

programme.title: Hollywood Shuffle
programme.desc: Aspiring actor and hot-dog stand employee Bobby Taylor (Robert Townsend) catches the ire of his grandmother (Helen Martin) for auditioning for a role in the regrettably titled exploitation film Jivetime Jimmy's Revenge. When Tinseltown Studios casts Taylor in the title role, he has a series of conflicted dreams satirizing African-American stereotypes in Hollywood, and must reconcile his career goals with his desire to remain a positive role model for his little brother (Craigus R Johnson).

programme.title: Rappin'
programme.desc: An ex-convict (Mario Van Peebles) shows residents of his Pittsburgh ghetto how to drive out riffraff with rap music.

programme.title: From the Rough
programme.desc: Catana Starks becomes the first woman to coach a collegiate men's golf team and subsequently guides her misfit players to an all-time-record championship season.

programme.title: Addicted
programme.desc: Successful businesswoman Zoe Reynard (Sharon Leal) seems to have a charmed life. She has a wonderful, loving husband (Boris Kodjoe), two beautiful children and a thriving career. However, as perfect as her life might look to other people, Zoe is secretly tormented by nymphomania. Her need for constant sexual gratification leads her into a secretive existence -- one that, ultimately, may put her family, career and life on the line. Based on a novel by Zane.

programme.title: Eve's Bayou
programme.desc: Over the course of a long, hot Louisiana summer, a 10-year-old black girl, Eve Batiste (Jurnee Smollett), discovers that her family's affluent existence is merely a facade. The philandering of her suave doctor father, Louis (Samuel L. Jackson), creates a rift, throwing Eve's mother, Roz (Lynn Whitfield), and teenage sister, Cicely (Meagan Good), into emotional turmoil. Eve, though, manages to find some solace with her quirky psychic aunt, Mozelle (Debbi Morgan).

programme.title: Out on Parole
programme.desc: An ex-con may miss a crucial meeting with his parole officer if he enters a low-rider contest to save his mother's home.

programme.title: Armed Response
programme.desc: Trained operatives find themselves trapped inside an isolated military compound after its artificial intelligence is suddenly shut down. There, they begin to experience strange and horrific phenomena.

programme.title: Monster's Ball
programme.desc: Hank, an embittered racist prison guard working on death row, begins an unlikely, emotionally charged sexual relationship with Leticia, a Black woman and wife of a man sentenced to death. The affair begins just after Hank oversees the capital punishment of Leticia's husband.

programme.title: Desaparecidos
programme.desc: Un hombre y una mujer viajan en el tiempo para comprobar la veracidad de una leyenda que afirma que un pueblo entero desapareció completamente.

programme.title: El Hombre sin Miedo
programme.desc: Un abogado americano cumple su amenaza de acabar con la familia de un hacendado cuando este le niega sus tierras.

programme.title: Morgana
programme.desc: El suicidio de una mujer demente a finales del siglo XIX tiene consecuencias terribles en la época actual. El miedo y el horror se apoderan especialmente de una jovencita en una pesadilla que parece llevarla directamente a su propia muerte.

programme.title: El Mofles y los Mecánicos
programme.desc: Un mecánico se topa con unos ladrones que huyen de la policía quienes dejan caer una bolsa llena de dinero.

programme.title: Verdugo de traidores
programme.desc: Un comandante de policía tiene que eliminar la corrupción que existe en su departamento a causa de los sobornos.

programme.title: Pasiones Infernales
programme.desc: Una mujer es maltratada por las mujeres de su aldea por el solo hecho de ser de color.

programme.desc: El Payo protege a su familia del bajo mundo del crimen, el cual quiere robarle su vida y su integridad.

programme.title: Yako, Cazador de Malditos
programme.desc: Yako tiene que vengarse del hombre que asesinó a su esposa embarazada.

programme.title: Fear Factor USA
programme.desc: Contestants would be required to strip down to their birthday suits, parade along the runway for one minute.

programme.title: Fear Factor USA
programme.desc: Contestants launch a piece of cow stomach to their partner on a small raft in the middle of a swamp. In this couples stunt, the contestants will be standing at a podium on the roof of a 5 story building. On "go" the couples much each complete an eating task. Once they have completed the above task they will be yanked off of the roof of the building and dangled from a crane.

programme.title: Fear Factor USA
programme.desc: Contestants will crawl down rope nets hanging from helicopters, collect flags before the floor fall out from under then, and ride motorcycles on a suspended beam.

programme.title: Fear Factor USA
programme.desc: Couples Episode - Contestants hold on to a spinning suspended beam, and look for Fear Factor tokens in disgusting pies

programme.title: Fear Factor USA
programme.desc: Family Special - Contestants will leap frog between rafts, traverse a tunnel filled with guts and complete an extreme obstacle course

programme.title: Fear Factor USA
programme.desc: Contestants will collect candy canes while sliding along a platform, gift gross food items with no take-backs, and swim under a flaming plexiglass grid.

programme.title: Fear Factor USA
programme.desc: Male contestants must identify disgusting items, then eat any they guess incorrectly; female contestants must retrieve dead feeder mice with their mouths while swimming in a vat of dead rodents.

programme.title: Fear Factor USA
programme.desc: This 30-minute clip show had highlights from animal stunts featured in the first three seasons of Fear Factor. Clips included worms, rats, snakes, bulls, bees, attack dogs, alligators, Madagascar hissing cockroaches, and scorpions.

programme.title: Fear Factor USA
programme.desc: Players must dive under a submarine and collect glow sticks; munching crickets; dropping from a crane.

programme.title: Fear Factor USA
programme.desc: Contestants take part in death-defying, stomach-churning stunts. This time, it's a high-flying challenge with saws and mud, outrunning attack dogs, and a suspended bus escape.
programme.sub-title: Burger King Viewers Choice Fear Factor

programme.title: Fear Factor USA
programme.desc: The first stunt is a real drag as contestants hold onto a cargo net being dragged behind a covered wagon pulled by two horses. They would have to pull themselves up the cargo net and get inside the wagon. It's a fishy dinner for the second stunt as they have to reach inside a dead 15-pound cod fish and pull out a numbered chip.
programme.sub-title: Stage Coach Drag/Cod Stew/Pipe to Pipe

programme.title: Fear Factor USA
programme.desc: Contestants take part in death-defying, stomach-churning stunts. This time, it's sailing through the air on a suspended cargo boat, a crabby escape, and a race against time while being buried in ice.

programme.title: Fear Factor USA
programme.desc: Contestants take part in death-defying, stomach-churning stunts. This time, it's escaping suspended cars and a conveyor belt challenge covered in tarantulas and crickets.

programme.title: Fear Factor USA
programme.desc: As a ferris wheel-like structure begins to move, the contestant must walk while keeping up with the constantly increasing speed of rotation. For the next challenge, a platform will start descending into the water until the contestants are completely submerged. They will have two locks that they must unlock to remove the chains to escape.

programme.title: Fear Factor USA
programme.desc: Models Episode - Players will 8free themselves from hanging in chains, pull alligator tails, and crawl between two helicopters with only a rope.

programme.title: Fear Factor USA
programme.desc: Couples must drive blind and trust their partner, save each other from tarantulas, and meet in the centre of a lake while handcuffed.

programme.title: Fear Factor USA
programme.desc: Contestants must run down a suspended tumbler without falling out, grab ground up bugs with their mouth, and help each other in a terrifying tanker truck task.

programme.title: Fear Factor USA
programme.desc: Contestants must jump between taxis, get in a coffin with roaches and escape, and grab money while being dunked in water from a crane.

programme.title: Fear Factor USA
programme.desc: Boat Jump As two ultra boats raced down a lake at 40 miles per hour, contestants would have to jump the gap between them that was approximately 7 feet wide and land on the second boat. Contestants who jumped from boat to boat successfully would advance to the next round.

programme.title: Fear Factor USA
programme.desc: Contestants will free fall from a 300 foot building, splatter bugs on their face like a windshield, and try not to fall from a rotating beam.

programme.title: Fear Factor USA
programme.desc: Contestants have to stand on top of a large plastic pipe and use their feet to roll it across beams from one rooftop to the other. The four that complete move on. In the second stunt, going two at a time, the four would use their mouths to pick up dead rats from a table and toss them into a bucket behind barricades.

programme.title: Fear Factor USA
programme.desc: Contestants will beam walk between helicopters, test bug shakes, and jump cars over trains.

programme.title: Fear Factor USA
programme.desc: Couples Episode - Players will be dragged by dune buggies, bury their teammates head in worms, and aim for a landing from a helicopter drop

programme.title: Fear Factor USA
programme.desc: Team Episode - Contestants will lock hands to traverse a high platform, pass around hagfish, and tight rope for victory.

programme.title: Wild Uruguay
programme.desc: Uruguay's biodiversity is surprisingly greater than one would expect. We will find out why as we embark on a journey through its ecosystems and landscapes to discover its fauna. Today we know that Uruguay is more than just the outermost edge of the Pampas, as the country holds a range of ecosystems. Within its borders, species of the Pampas come face to face with species of the Atlantic Forest, the Misiones rainforest, and the Chaco forest, giving rise to unexpected encounters.

programme.title: Wildest Survival
programme.desc: Whether by wing, fin or hoof, epic migrations are among nature's most awe-inspiring events. Animals undertake these arduous journeys, for many reasons: to find a mate, to give birth, or to move to new feeding grounds. And danger lurks at every turn. In this episode we discover the lengths they go to in order to survive.

programme.title: The Enchanted Forest
programme.desc: To spend a day in the forest, from dawn to dusk, is to bathe in nature. There's enchantment at every turn. Throughout the day the cast of characters in the forest changes, from foraging bears to playing fox cubs, dashing hummingbirds and dancing butterflies. But it's as twilight descends, that the most enchanting side of the forest is revealed. Time to watch a firework display curtesy of fireflies. They are the real magicians of the enchanted forest.

programme.title: World of the Wild
programme.desc: Some of the most beautiful rainforest, jungle landscape and wildlife are in Asia. The rainforests of Asia stretch from India and Burma in the west to Malaysia and the islands of Java and Borneo in the east. The Great teak forests and Jungles in Asia have long been under threat from intensive logging and industrial farming of cash crops. Slash and burn agriculture has also taken a heavy toll on the eco-structure and environment. Bangladesh has the largest mangrove forests in the world.

programme.title: World of the Wild
programme.desc: Large areas of water, broken up by small islands. Massive vegetation. Swamps, wetlands, marshes, bogs and fens are found all over the world, generally in more temperate regions where there is fast vegetation growth. Many of the larger animals that inhabit swamps and wetlands have a fish-based diet. LARGE CRABS dwell in the salt-water swamps, along with SNAPPING TURTLES and even CROCODILES AND ALLIGATORS. LIZARDS AND AMPHIBIANS live in and around the water's edge.

programme.title: World of the Wild
programme.desc: Deserts - dry, arid landscapes, environments of intense sun, heat and very little rain. The desert is extreme. An extre-me climate and an extreme environment where wild life has had to adapt to survive. Many of the animals that live in deserts have adopted a nocturnal lifestyle, surfacing only at night when it is cooler.

programme.title: Seasons Of The Otter
programme.desc: One of the most loves animals, famed for its playful nature and incredible underwater agility. Yet most of the life of the otter goes unseen. Following the first year in the life of a young otter family, we'll reveal the secrets of the otter's world. Otter life is often a challenge, and especially so for a young family trying to make it through winter. Two pups were born last spring, and as they approach their first birthdays the time with their mother is coming to its end.

programme.title: Cost of Progress
programme.desc: The natural world is in crisis. For years humanity has exploited the planet's resources, and the creatures that live here. Growth and innovation can be a marvelous thing, but at what cost to our one and only planet? When we continue to push ahead blindly, it's more often than not Mother Nature that pays the price. Now it is time for us to rally - to take heed and start to turn back the tide. It's time for us to recognize our part in this crisis and redress the balance of the cost of progress.

programme.title: Destination Wild - Wild Argentina
programme.desc: This episode follows the animals of Argentina, living life at the mercy of the Andean mountains. These peaks dictate a hard existence for every living creature from their summits to the very edge of the Patagonian steppe, forcing even the cutest resident to turn carnivore... Predators stalk the foothills and creepy crawlies lie low in the sandy steppe. Every animal here has a bloodthirsty drive to survive.

programme.title: Rhino Orphanage
programme.desc: The two oldest rhinos are set to be released back into the wild. Three rhinos cause a stir as they go missing, while the younger rhinos make steady progress toward health and happiness. A new volunteer arrives in time to see the release, but will it end in disaster?

programme.title: January (Nature's Calendar)
programme.desc: In Europe in January, we sit around in the dark, missing the bright lights and festivities of Christmas, perhaps it would cheer us up to imagine January around the world. To the north, polar bear cubs are born and nestle against their hibernating mothers, but on the other side of the planet, kangaroos are experiencing the highest temperatures and having to trek in search of water, while in East Africa, wildebeest arrive on their breeding grounds and enjoy a baby-boom on a giant scale.

programme.title: Costa Rica: The Rise of Nature
programme.desc: The dry forest, which once covered the entire Pacific coast of Central America, now exists only as isolated "vestiges". In Costa Rica, however, it has been revived and even expanded thanks to the efforts of biologists and the local population. Here, the population of jaguars, a top predator, is increasing. This unique forest - dense, abundant and colorful during the rainy season, camouflaged and asleep during the dry season - is home to a splendid diversity of plants, trees and wildlife.

programme.title: Fight for Life
programme.desc: Nature is red in tooth and claw - animals face daily battles to protect themselves and secure the resources they need to survive. Every battle is a trade-off between energy spent, the risk to health and the prizes awarded to the victors. Each fighter has a unique set of tools and techniques available to dispatch their opponents. For predators to find food, lower links in the food chain have a fight on their hands escaping the jaws of death. Their only options are to die, run or turn and fight.

programme.title: Wild and Alive
programme.desc: On the coast of south Africa, a group of mammoth mammals is arriving from the deep ocean. Every year humpback and southern right whales make incredible migrations from the Antarctic seas to mate and give birth along southern Africa's rich protected coast. Just arriving in time won't be enough to guarantee a mate. Humpbacks conduct awe-inspiring aerial displays and chaotic competitions for attention before showing off their grace in underwater ballets.

programme.title: Deserts
programme.desc: All habitats present difficulties, but the challenges of the desert are more obvious than most - scorching heat and a lack food and water make them one of the most hostile environments on the planet. But with great challenges come incredible solutions. Despite the deadly conditions, a hardy band of unique animal and plant species have adapted to meet the inhospitable desert conditions head on.

programme.title: World's Wildest City: Anchorage
programme.desc: Anchorage is home to hundreds of black bears. And it's these black bears, that are patrolling the city. With their brains, their brawn and their cunning, these bears have mastered life in this urban jungle. When Spring arrives the bears hit the city as it's time to start eating. And these bears have found a source of food that is much easier to catch than a slippery salmon - it's trash. And it is everywhere. The city's bins and dumpsters have become the perfect bear restaurant.

programme.title: Magical Fjords
programme.desc: Fjords are one of the most dramatic landscapes on Earth, but their majesty is just the tip of the iceberg. Fjords stand witness to some of the greatest wonders of the animal kingdom. Fjords are found in a frozen land where only the toughest survive. Whether just below the surface, at the murky depths of the sea floor or on dry land, the fjords offer an incredible bounty to wildlife.

programme.title: Meet the Mustelids
programme.desc: To many ears the name mustelid might sound mysterious and confusing. They may sound strange, but this family of hunters are probably much more familiar than you think. They're tiny terrors; ankle-height tigers of the undergrowth. From the icy northern climbs where the bold wolverine quietly rules the forests, scattering wolves with a fearsome glance, to the sun-drenched wetlands of the Amazon where man-sized giant otters work together to protect their families and defend their homes.

programme.title: Lion - Africa's Super Power
programme.desc: The endless plains of East Africa is a paradise for lions. The most social of all cats, lions form prides that are unlike any other animals. Together, they'll hunt, raise their young and defend their territory. With such a close family and plentiful home, the pride welcomes new babies every year. But new children introduces new dangers.

programme.title: Wildest Islands
programme.desc: Lying 40km off the east coast of Tanzania in Africa, the Zanzibar Archipelago has been labelled the most exotic island chain in the world. Pristine sands and azure blue sea make it a much loved holiday destination, but bizarre creatures, many of enormous size, also roam the islands. The world's largest crab scales trees in search of coconuts, and clouds of giant bats fill the skies at dusk.

programme.title: Coasts - Life's a Beach
programme.desc: To us the beach is one giant playground, but for wildlife it's a place to live, to find food and to raise their young. Amongst the fish and chips, sandcastles and donkey rides it's easy to forget that beaches are vital habitats, home to a myriad of animals. Whether grey seals are duelling for a mate and raising their young, or black bears and tigers are scouring the coastline for a tasty snack, animals have been using the beach for millennia.

programme.title: World's Wildest City: Anchorage
programme.desc: Bred from wolves, Huskies have helped humans carve out an existence in Alaska's desolate wilderness. These dogs still maintain many physical adaptations of their wild ancestors, enabling them to withstand the fierce conditions of the Alaskan winter. And in Alaska's most extreme terrain, sled dogs are still the only form of transport. In the south, the modern city of Anchorage is still home to the start of the World's Toughest Race, a 1000 mile sled-dog race, known as the Iditarod.

programme.title: Meet the Meerkats
programme.desc: Meerkats live in close families and rely on their companions to watch their backs. In their vast and unforgiving home of the Namib desert, only together can they defeat the odds stacked against them. One young female is forced from her group, overcoming a brutal attack from the alpha pair and fearing for her life. Cast out and left to fend for herself, she has no choice but to roam the desert and find a way to live.

programme.title: Migrations - Frequent Flyers
programme.desc: Migration is one of the most remarkable phenomena of the natural world, and perhaps the most impressive migrants of all travel on the wing.

programme.title: Nuts About Squirrels
programme.desc: Even in our most urban settings, pretty much all of us know squirrels. They can be divisive charac-ters; some people adore them, offering them food, while others see them as glorified rats. But we can all agree that these are speedy, quirky, and exceptional characters. They also go crazy for nuts. They've conquered most of the globe, from icy tundra to the hottest deserts, developing ingen-ious life skills along the way, from stashing nuts to fighting snakes.

programme.title: Fighting for a Mate
programme.desc: Animals face daily battles to protect themselves and secure the resources they need to survive. Every battle is a trade-off between the risk to health and the prizes awarded to the victors. Each animal fights with a unique set of tools, from display structures and elaborate body language to claws, jaws and antlers. And few fights are as fuelled as those during breeding season; the ultimate trophy for the brave fighter is, of course, a chance to pass on the fighting genes to the next generation.

programme.title: Scream 4
programme.desc: It has been many years since the Ghostface Killer cut a deadly path through the town of Woodsboro. In order to get over the trauma of those horrific events, Sidney Prescott (Neve Campbell) has written a self-help book. She returns to Woodsboro for her book tour, and reconnects with old friends Gale Weathers (Courteney Cox) and Sheriff Dewey (David Arquette). However, Sidney's arrival also sparks the return of Ghostface, putting Sidney and everyone she loves in danger.

programme.title: Sinister
programme.desc: True-crime writer Ellison Oswald is in a slump; he hasn't had a bestseller in more than 10 years and is becoming increasingly desperate for a hit. So, when he discovers the existence of a snuff film showing the deaths of a family, he vows to solve the mystery. He moves his own family into the victims' home and gets to work. However, when old film footage and other clues hint at the presence of a supernatural force, Ellison learns that living in the house may be fatal.

programme.title: Come to Daddy
programme.desc: A privileged man-child arrives at the beautiful and remote coastal cabin of his estranged father, whom he hasn't seen in 30 years. He quickly discovers that not only is his dad a jerk, he also has a shady past that is rushing to catch up with him.

programme.title: Scary Stories to Tell in the Dark
programme.desc: The shadow of the Bellows family has loomed large in the small town of Mill Valley for generations. It's in a mansion that young Sarah Bellows turns her tortured life and horrible secrets into a series of scary stories. These terrifying tales soon have a way of becoming all too real for a group of unsuspecting teens who stumble upon Sarah's spooky home.

programme.title: Steel Dawn
programme.desc: A post-World War III swordsman (Patrick Swayze) defends a desert widow (Lisa Niemi) and her water-treatment farm.

programme.title: Gods of Egypt
programme.desc: The survival of mankind hangs in the balance when Set, the merciless god of darkness, usurps Egypt's throne and plunges the prosperous empire into chaos and conflict. Hoping to save the world and rescue his true love, a defiant mortal named Bek forms an unlikely alliance with the powerful god Horus. Their battle against Set and his henchmen takes them into the afterlife and across the heavens for an epic confrontation.

programme.title: Conan the Barbarian
programme.desc: A powerful Cimmerian warrior, Conan carves a bloody path across the land of Hyboria on a personal vendetta. That soon turns into an epic battle against evil, for Conan's mortal enemy, Khalar Zym, seeks the legendary Mask of Acheron. The artifact will enable Khalar Zym to raise his wife from the dead and achieve immortality for himself, but it will also unleash a malevolent force upon the land, and only Conan and his companions can stop it.

programme.title: Robin Hood
programme.desc: After returning home to England, aristocrat Robin of Loxley learns that the evil Sheriff of Nottingham has seized his family estate. He soon joins forces with Friar Tuck and Little John -- a fierce Arabian warrior who wants to put an end to the Crusades. Armed with arrows and dubbed Robin Hood, Loxley leads a band of oppressed rebels in a daring plan to rob the Sheriff of his money and take away his power.

programme.title: Hirokin
programme.desc: A warrior (Wes Bentley) leads an uprising against the ruler (Julian Sands) of a planet.

programme.title: Akeelah and the Bee
programme.desc: Akeelah, an 11-year-old girl living in South Los Angeles, discovers she has a talent for spelling, which she hopes will take her to the National Spelling Bee.

programme.title: The Great Debaters
programme.desc: Poet and professor Melvin B. Tolson teaches at the predominantly black Wiley College in 1935 Texas. He decides to start a debate team, something nearly unheard of at a black college. While at first he butts heads with the influential father of one of his best debaters, eventually he is able to form a team of strong-minded, intelligent young students, and they become the first black debate team to challenge Harvard's prestigious debate champions.

programme.title: Pride
programme.desc: In the 1970s Philadelphia, Jim Ellis, who is driven by a love of competitive swimming, fixes up an abandoned pool building with the help of a janitor named Elston. But when city officials mark the place for demolition, he fights back by founding an all-black swim team. Facing racism, violence and a hostile city official, Jim struggles to prepare his novice swimmers for the state championships.

programme.title: Draft Day
programme.desc: Sonny Weaver Jr. is the general manager of the Cleveland Browns. One of pro football's most important days, NFL draft day, is drawing near, but Sonny has much more on his mind than just which players to recruit. His lover is pregnant, and the team's owner wants to fire him. After Sonny accepts a deal with Seattle that nets him that team's first-round pick, he immediately wonders if he has made the right choice for himself and the Browns.

programme.title: Hands of Stone
programme.desc: At age 72, legendary trainer Ray Arcel (Robert De Niro) comes out of retirement to coach world-class Panamanian boxer Roberto Durán (Edgar Ramírez). Arcel becomes a mentor to the ferocious fighter, convincing him that winning ultimately comes down to strategy. After scoring knockout after knockout, Duran prepares for a bout against Sugar Ray Leonard, the undefeated lightweight champion. Five months later, on Nov. 25, 1980, the two titans meet for an infamous rematch that makes boxing history.

programme.title: Imperium
programme.desc: An idealistic FBI agent goes undercover to infiltrate a white supremacist group that's plotting an act of terror.

programme.title: Snitch
programme.desc: At 18 years old, Jason receives a mandatory 10-year prison sentence after being caught with a package that contained illegal drugs, although he was unaware of its contents. His father, businessman John Matthews (Dwayne Johnson), is devastated. When Jason turns down a chance to lessen his sentence by manufacturing evidence to implicate someone else, John begs to be sent undercover instead, but the already dangerous venture turns deadly after he exposes a major player in the Mexican drug trade.

programme.title: Alex Cross
programme.desc: Alex Cross (Tyler Perry) works as a detective/psychologist for the Detroit Police Department along with his lifelong friend, Tommy Kane (Edward Burns), and detective Monica Ashe (Rachel Nichols). Cross' latest case puts him on a collision course with Picasso (Matthew Fox), a cunning serial killer whose ultimate target is multinational industrialist Giles Mercier (Jean Reno). Cross must find a way inside Picasso's head not only to catch the killer but also to stem the violent urges Cross feels.

programme.title: Brooklyn's Finest
programme.desc: A drug operation changes the lives of three conflicted New York cops. Burned-out vet Eddie Dugan is close to retirement; narcotics cop Sal Procida faces the difficult task of caring for his large family on his ordinary salary. Undercover officer Clarence Tango Butler finds his loyalties beginning to shift toward a powerful drug dealer. Over seven chaotic days, the three men are drawn toward a fateful crime and destiny.

programme.title: Destroyer
programme.desc: As a young cop, Erin Bell went undercover to infiltrate a gang in the California desert -- with tragic results. Bell continues to work as a detective for the Los Angeles Police Department, but feelings of anger and remorse leave her worn-down and consumed by guilt. When the leader of that gang suddenly re-emerges, Erin embarks on an obsessive quest to find his former associates, bring him to justice and make peace with her tortured past.

programme.desc: For Grant's last episode of Ghost Hunters, the TAPS team decides to stay close to home and investigate Jason and Grant's very own Spalding Inn. GHI investigated their Inn before, but this will be TAPS' first opportunity. The Spalding Inn was originally a summer home named Cherry Hill House that began taking in guests in 1865. It was renamed the Spalding Inn in 1926 when Randall and Anna Spalding took over.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On the first episode back since Grant made his announcement that he wasleaving, TAPS pushes forward focusing on the case on hand. They head to the University of Rhode Island to investigate a Fraternity house that has been experiencing paranormal activity for decades. Purchased in 1936, a former Governor once resided in the house, and there is a claim that his little girl, Abigail, fell to her death there.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS heads to South Carolina, the winner of America's Hometown Ghost Hunters Contest, to investigate the renowned Old City Jail. This historical Jail was the final destination of America's first female serial killer, Lavinia Fisher. It's believed that Lavinia still lingers in the prison and it is up to TAPS to determine if that's true. This site has been around since 1738, when it was first used as a workhouse for slaves and a makeshift hospital for paupers, vagrants, and beggars.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS heads out on their first case since co-founder Grant Wilson left. This case takes them to New Orleans, Louisiana to investigate what's locally known as the Upstairs Fire at Jimani Lounge. The current owner, Jimmy Jr. was only 12 years old when an arsonist set fire to his father's club on June 24th, 1973. 32 men died trying to escape, but because these men were associated with the gay community, many bodies were never claimed, therefore, victims were never identified. Jimmy Jr.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS is called back to Alexandria, Louisiana to investigate the Alexandria Zoo, where the apparition of the longtime zookeeper and manager, Les has been seen. Les' longtime friend, Bill Hess called in TAPS after many longtime employees and friends noticed strange paranormal activity that reminded them of their dear friend. TAPS also introduces a new member, Ashley to the team and Jason promotes Adam to his new position, Investigator.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS is asked to investigate Fort Ontario, a place that was the only location in America to provide sanctuary for Jewish refugees during World War II. Built in 1755, this fort first saw battle during the French and Indian war, and is no stranger to bloodshed. ...and phenomena.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS heads to Joliet, Illinois to investigate that Rialto Square Theater. In the 1920's the Rialto Square Theater hosted famous entertainers and vaudeville stars. But in the 1930's an accident took place right outside the theater where a little boy was hit by a car and then later dies inside. People in the theater have since claimed to see the little boy, who they named Kevin, and experienced other eerie paranormal activity.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Claremont, New Hampshire to investigate a former shoe and furniture factory, the Topstone Mill. What was once an abandoned space has now become a restaurant and bar... with frequent visitors from "the other side." Could deceased workers from the 1900's be trying to contact a mother and son team who own the bar? TAPS has surprising evidence that could point in that direction.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Lockport, New York to investigate an underworld of tunnels. It holds a mystery of possible murders, multiple deaths and frightening phenomena. What stories do the spirits of Lockport Caves want to tell? Will TAPS be able to reassure their client that visitors will be safe if they venture on one of the longest underground boat rides in America? Next up, the team travels to Skaneateles, New York to investigate the Fuller House.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS travels to Hampton Falls, New Hampshire to investigate the Governor's Mansion, a property Steve has investigated before with a local team. Could this estate's hauntings be connected to a sad secret surrounding a little boy who is believed to have once lived here in the late 1800's? Will TAPS be able to reach this child and find out if he was in fact the hidden legitimate son of State Senator, Warren Brown? Could the State Senator have been behind his murder?

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS heads to Bowling Green, Kentucky to investigate Western Kentucky University. This University was established in 1906 and has 20,000 students attending. Tamela Smith is the client, and has called TAPS in to figure out if some of the stories that have been passed down over the decades are folklore or truth. There are three main stories that surround the school.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Rochester, New York to investigate the Rochester Public Library's 15 years of claims. There's reason to believe that two deaths associated with the building could be behind the activity. The library wants to go public with the phenomena but only if accurate. Can TAPS find the answer they are looking for and finally let the public in on this library's long-held secret?

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS returns to Hartford, Connecticut to investigate the Mark Twain House. With their previous investigation marred by malfunctioning equipment, TAPS is being called back to look into new and frightening claims that could finally uncover who is residing there. Will Samuel Clemens' favorite holiday initiate an appearance from the famous author? Or will his three children try to reach out to TAPS?

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Hollywood, California to investigate the infamous Black Dahlia murder at the historic Sowden House. Aspiring actress, Elizabeth Short was nicknamed the Black Dahlia after her brutal murder and the leading suspect of that horrific crime was never convicted. Two people have called in TAPS; the first being the main murder suspects own son, Steve Hodel.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Bartonville, Illinois, to investigate Peoria Asylum. The owners are renovating this building and have noticed a lot of paranormal activity since they started their restorations. Built in 1898 and opened in 1902, it is said that 16,000 people died there, from multiple reasons, including, patients killing patients and suicide. The asylum's records hold two key figures; Dr.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Cortland, New York to investigate The 1890 House. Industrialist, Chester Wickwire built this home for his family, and even though they have long passed, it's believed by some that the family may still reside here. Michelle, the caretaker, is concerned that the spirits may follow her home. Do the Wickwire's still live in their former home and if so, can TAPS help put Michelle's mind at ease that they mean her no harm?

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Louisville, Kentucky to investigate the oldest operating steamboat in the United States. The boat was built in 1914 and has been used for everything from dances to gambling. Its former Captain Winters was legendary for being somewhat shady. It's claimed that he killed a deckhand named Floyd during an argument when he sent him to do work on the paddle wheel and then ordered full steam ahead, which killed Floyd.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS travels to Sylvan Beach Park in Sylvan Beach, New York to investigate a theme park originally built in the 1890's. Sylvan Beach Park used to be referred to as the Coney Island of Central New York, with its famous hotels, lakeside attractions, and amusement rides. Now Sylvan Beach holds a haunted history and TAPS has been asked to investigate, much to the unease of some of the employees who fear the investigation will agitate the spirits further.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Shreveport, Louisiana to investigate the Shreveport Auditorium, a place that is famous for introducing Elvis to the world. Shreveport Auditorium opened in 1929 and is considered a national landmark. The auditorium's stage has been graced by such stars as Hank Williams and Johnny Cash and is known as the first place Elvis preformed professionally. A statue of Elvis was erected after he passed and that's when the phenomena is said to have begun.
programme.sub-title: The Ghost Hasn't Left the Building

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Little Rock, Arkansas to investigate a personal case at the Jones House and their bungalow next door. Robberies, fires, assault, and murder have all taken place in the old bungalow, dating back to 1898, when Ed Cornish had his wife and two children die 16 hours apart. Then in 2005 Bonnie Wallace, the Jones' neighbor, was murdered by an acquaintance in the bungalow and her husband, Paul died shortly after from illness.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS is called to Liberty, Missouri to investigate the Belvoir Winery; a property that has four buildings that are being renovated to become a retirement facility and winery. These buildings were at one time an orphanage, an old folks home, a hospital, and a nursing home and have seen over 10,000 deaths through the years.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: The Elms Resort & Spa in Excelsior Springs, Missouri was built in the 1880's to accommodate the thousands of visitors flocking to the area, which had rapidly gained a reputation of having mineral springs with magical healing powers. The first Elms Resort was opened in 1888 and burned down in 1898. They opened a new hotel in 1912 (which has recently been renovated).

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Monticello, Arkansas to investigate The Allen Mansion, built in 1906 by a wealthy businessman named Joe Allen. He lived there with his wife and three daughters. One of Joe Allen's daughters, Ladell is believed to have committed suicide in the mansion at the age of 54 years because of her divorce and later losing her son to pneumonia.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Shreveport, Louisiana to investigate two buildings that may share the same paranormal activity. The client, Grayson owns the 1800's era Rendall Building, which is across the street from the second building with activity, the Caddo Parish Courthouse. They are thought to be connected because it's believed that the The Rendall building's basement once acted as a cold storage facility for those who were hanged at the Courthouse.

programme.title: Coolest Places on Earth

programme.sub-title: Peeling Back The Layers Of Vidalia

programme.title: Foodie Road Trip With Skye Estroff

programme.sub-title: Skye And The Tybeans Of Tybee Island

programme.title: The Cigar Vixen
programme.desc: Cuba has long been renowned for its world-class cigars. Not only will Delicia introduce you to the finest tobacco, but she will also reveal the many facets of Cuba's spectacular culture.

programme.title: The Cigar Vixen

programme.title: This Old House TV
programme.desc: Coming up on This Old House The show opens with Kevin at the busy Jamestown job site, where the yard has been ripped up by the heavy machinery. In just a few short weeks the grass will go in, and luckily Roger has a good solution. Roger joins Jenn and Kevin at a nearby sod farm where hundreds of acres of environmentally-friendly grass is grown. They learn about a variety with microclover that requires less water and uses no pesticides and fertilizer.
programme.sub-title: Roger's Nod to Sod | The Jamestown Net Zero House

programme.title: Dermot Bannon's Incredible Homes
programme.desc: Dermot hops across the Irish Sea to have the proverbial nosey around some amazing houses. Dermot has been to London many times. As a student in Hull studying architecture, he would make his way down to the capital and wander around the streets, taking in the architectural landscape. Now, he gets to go inside!

programme.title: The Life-Sized City
programme.desc: Since the 2015 World Expo, the city of Milan has redefined itself with new skyscrapers, public and private initiatives and urban renewal projects.

programme.title: Chuck and the First Peoples' Kitchen
programme.desc: In Iqaluit, Chuck meets Solomon Awa who invites Chuck on a hunting expedition for ptarmigan. Chuck also visits the Qajuqturvik Community Food Centre where fighting food insecurity is their mission.

programme.title: Tiny Paradise
programme.desc: After feeling the need to downsize and live simply, a woman and her best friend decide to build a tiny home in the jungle paradise of Hilo, HI. While their dreams of a tiny Hawaiian hideaway are big, both lack adequate construction experience. Will they be able to make their tiny dream a sustainable reality?

programme.title: Log Cabin Fever
programme.desc: The Southern Appalachian Highlands Conservancy, a repeat client of Charlie Norman's, needs a reliable shelter constructed for weary hikers and campers trekking the Appalachian Trail. Drawing from the techniques used to build old barns, Charlie and his crew erect a pavilion -- but not without taking a break to visit the weathered cabin of a long-ago hiker.

programme.title: Holmes Inspection
programme.desc: Keep the peace in a multi-generational home full of conflicting needs.

programme.title: The Travel Detective
programme.desc: CBS News Travel Editor Peter Greenberg takes us down under to Australia's most populous city - beyond the Opera House and Bondi Beach - to show us places that only the locals know about. Plus, a rundown of the world's most traffic-congested cities. Then, the World Happiness Report has a new country on top of that list, find out why it was chosen!

programme.title: Crown & Country
programme.desc: Salisbury is an area steeped in myth and legend, from Stonehenge to the spire in Salisbury Cathedral.

programme.title: Dermot Bannon's Incredible Homes
programme.desc: Dermot arrives in Swedish Lapland in the depths of winter. Straightaway, he has to get to grips with the darkness and the severe weather. In the far North the sun doesn't set at all in June and there is darkness around the clock in January. He discovers that rather than fighting against the darkness and the weather, Swedish design embraces them...and the results are enlightening.

programme.title: Class Dismissed

programme.title: Finders Keepers
programme.desc: Jaylin is a struggling single father trying to support his children and make ends meet. His friend Reg sets him up with a job as a delivery driver, but is still struggling. One day, he and Reg discover a box a pills. Jaylin wants to turn them in, but Reg convinces him to try and sell the pills, as it will help support his family. A gang of thugs begins to descend on them, as the pills are worth more than they originally thought.

programme.title: Soulful and Funny Episode 5 Just Oxtails
programme.desc: Get ready for some island vibes, as Crystal takes you down to Houston where we're introduced to Just Oxtails in Missouri City, Texas. Locally owned and operated, Just Oxtails has been a local staple for the last twenty years where they've built a brand on "Just Oxtails!" Then we're joined by comedienne Lotto Marie who brings the laughs about her mid-west upbringing.

programme.title: Soulful and Funny Episode 6 Mo City
programme.desc: Continuing our tour of Missouri City in Houston, Texas, Crystal takes us to Micheaux's a local restaurant that made a name for themselves during the pandemic by giving back to the community through their "Everybody Eats" program. Owner Mr. Mischeaux serves up traditional southern Louisiana family recipes that include their signature Salmon, Five Cheese Macaroni & Cheese, and Peach Cobbler.

programme.title: The Price of Fame
programme.desc: In the streets of Atlanta, Cassie, a struggling young woman searching for purpose, meets Ryan, a charismatic interviewer who offers her a chance to step into the world of fame and opportunity. With guidance from her cunning best friend, Ledrick, Cassie navigates the glamorous yet cutthroat entertainment industry. But as hidden agendas and betrayals emerge, Cassie finds herself questioning the cost of her dreams.

programme.title: Swept
programme.desc: Five old friends receive invitations to their 20 - year high school reunion, hoping to connect and reminisce. Little do they know, they've all been keeping a secret about events that unfolded over twenty years ago. Will secrets stay buried? Or with the weight of their guilt finally tear them apart?

programme.title: Plenty
programme.desc: Rae Jones is a talented, edgy, street-forged sexy 20-something, desperate to become a working actress. After years of dead end auditions and exploitation in music videos, she finally gets the break of a lifetime. But can she maintain the balance between the greedy Hollywood demands of being a rising young star with the indebtedness she feels to her often-unscrupulous family and the seedy Atlanta strip club where she was discovered?

programme.title: All The Man I Need
programme.desc: All The Man I Need is about a 39 year old Financial Planner and Investment Strategist named Erica, who has a successful career in finding the right investments for her clients, but has been unsuccessful in finding love and the "right man" for herself.

programme.title: Do's and Don'ts of Dating
programme.desc: Ladies' man Scott Hall thinks he has the dating game figured out. He has dating rules that he follows until he meets his match. Will she throw him off his game?

programme.title: Boxed In 2
programme.desc: After overcoming insurmountable odds, Ria finds herself a rising boxing star. She has everything she could ever imagine with the exception of one thing: love. She meets El by chance and starts to let go of her past disappointments and grab ahold of hope for the future. But with anything, nothing is ever as it seems. Faced with new revelations, Ria will have to decide if it's worth fighting for the sport she believes in and most importantly, the one she believes in.

programme.title: Let's Shake On It
programme.desc: A simple dinner date turns into a fun loving challenge when Brian(Jarrett Glover) insists he can prepare a better meal then what he was served at a resteraunt. His girlfriend Trina(Tia Pratcher) is sure he'll fail especially since he has a reputation for burning food but will reward him if the meal is quality by treating him to an annual music festival. He plans to use his grandmothers secret recipes to win but is faced with an unforeseen obstacle trying to obtain it.

programme.title: All I See Is You [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Gina is a beautiful young woman who's still haunted by the accident that took her sight years earlier. Living in Bangkok with her husband, James, she undergoes a cutting-edge operation that restores the vision to her right eye. Now that Gina can see again, she slowly starts to realize that her newfound independence makes James feel jealous, threatened and insecure.

programme.title: Blind Horizon [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Found in the New Mexico desert with a head wound and total amnesia, Frank Kavanaugh (Val Kilmer) is brought to a hospital. When he recovers some of his memory, he begins raving about an upcoming assassination attempt on the president. Despite the man's unstable state, Sheriff Jack Kolb (Sam Shepard) is troubled by Frank's story. Discovering the truth grows more complicated when Chloe Richards (Neve Campbell) arrives and claims to be Frank's fiancée, even though he has no memory of her.

programme.title: My Baby Gone
programme.desc: Pregnant Emily bonds quickly with her pregnant neighbor Kelly, but Kelly is faking it and plans to steal Emily's baby.

programme.title: The Getaway (1994) [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: An ex-con and his devoted wife must flee from danger when a heist doesn't go as planned.

programme.title: Chef [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: After a controlling owner (Dustin Hoffman) pushes him too far, chef Carl Casper (Jon Favreau) quits his position at a prestigious Los Angeles restaurant. As he tries to figure out what his next step should be, he finds himself in Miami. Carl joins forces with his ex-wife (Sofía Vergara), best friend (John Leguizamo) and son (Emjay Anthony) to launch a food-truck business, and the venture provides a chance to reignite his passion for cooking -- as well as his zest for life and love.

programme.title: Going All The Way [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Korean War--era veterans and ex-classmates "Gunner" Casselman (Ben Affleck) and "Sonny" Burns (Jeremy Davies) reunite upon their return home. Gunner, who spent the war years abroad, is trying to convince his mother that his gal Marty (Rachel Weisz) is good enough for him, while Sonny, who was stationed stateside, is torn between loyal Buddy (Amy Locane) and tempting Gale Ann (Rose McGowan). As they commiserate, the men realize that they're outgrowing the lives they lived before the war.

programme.title: My Mom's New Boyfriend
programme.desc: After several years away, FBI agent Henry Durand (Colin Hanks) returns to find his mother, Marty (Meg Ryan), a much different person: Having long mourned for Henry's father, she is now embracing single life. One day, while Marty, Henry and his new fiancée, Emily (Selma Blair), are out for a walk, they meet Tommy (Antonio Banderas), a mysterious stranger, with whom Marty then becomes involved. However, through his FBI contacts, Henry learns that Tommy is suspected of being an art thief.

programme.title: Before I Go To Sleep [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Ever since a vicious attack nearly claimed her life, Christine Lucas (Nicole Kidman) has suffered from anterograde amnesia and is unable to form new memories. Every morning, she becomes reacquainted with her husband, Ben (Colin Firth), and the other constants in her life. In accordance with her doctor's (Mark Strong) instructions, Christine keeps a video diary. As Christine starts to uncover terrifying truths about her past, she begins to question everything -- and everyone -- around her.

programme.title: Direct Contact
programme.desc: An American prisoner in a Russian jail is given a chance at freedom if he can rescue a kidnapped woman.

programme.title: Homeboy [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Though only in his 20s, professional boxer Johnny Walker is on the downswing of his career and suffering from a mild form of brain damage. Resettling in the beachfront resort of Asbury Park, N.J., he falls in with shady promoter Wesley Pendergass and meets kindhearted boardwalk operator Ruby. When Wesley proposes cutting Johnny in on a criminal undertaking, Johnny must choose between a life of crime and a settled future with Ruby.

programme.title: The Contract
programme.desc: Frank Carden (Morgan Freeman), one of the world's greatest assassins, is handed a lucrative contract to kill a highly secretive billionaire. But in a twist of fate, Carden is involved in a car accident during the job, and when his gun is found after he is admitted to a hospital, federal marshals arrest him. Meanwhile, ex-cop Ray Keene (John Cusack) is hiking with his son, Chris (Jamie Anderson), when Carden's cohorts try to spring him from custody, and soon the pair is caught in the crossfire.

programme.title: Mercenary for Justice
programme.desc: As a mercenary, John Seeger (Steven Seagal) has a reputation that precedes him. That's why he's being blackmailed into performing a risky job: breaking the son of a wealthy arms dealer out of a South African prison. With his friends taken hostage, Seeger agrees to do the deed -- but finds out too late that he's been double-crossed. Not one who likes being taken for a fool, Seeger hatches an elaborate plan to get even that will make the prison break look like capture the flag.

programme.desc: In 2016, over 200 unseen photos of Nazi officials surfaced, revealing the rise of a young Hitlerite group in concentration camps between 1928-1943. Dr. Stefan Hördler spent 5 years analyzing the images, uncovering how these men became perpetrators of horrific crimes. This investigation exposes a little-known chapter of the camps and challenges assumptions about their origins.
programme.sub-title: Unmasking the Killers of the Third Reich

programme.title: Bomber Operations: Target For Tonight
programme.desc: 1941 Film - The planning and implementation of an RAF night raid on Germany in World War II, concentrating on a low level mission by a Wellington bomber on an oil storage facility by the Rhine.

programme.title: D-Day: The Longest of Days
programme.desc: Invasion of Southern France by the 7th army and subsequent junction with the American 3rd army in northwest part of France.

programme.title: U.S. Marines in Vietnam
programme.desc: Operation Dewey Canyon, from January 22 through March 18, 1969, was the last major offensive by the United States Marine Corps during the Vietnam War. The 9th Marine Regiment reinforced by elements of the 3rd Marine Regiment swept through the A Shau Valley engaging in 56 days of combat mainly against the North Vietnamese Army.

programme.title: Heroes Never Die: The Miniseries
programme.desc: With English Closed Captions. A group of Ukrainian Army fighters heads to Donetsk airport for its defense. After being shelled by artillery on the way, a team of four volunteer fighters makes it to the airport to help reinforce. The name Cyborgs, Defenders of the Donetsk Airport, is given to the Ukrainian fighters for their grit, bravery and heroics.

programme.title: The Vietnam War: Jungles of Death
programme.desc: The story of the Vietnam War from the perspective of both sides, including rare war time footage from North Vietnamese sources.

programme.title: Hitler's Last Secrets: Hitler the Drifter
programme.desc: Drawing upon the often overlooked memoirs of his erstwhile friend Reinhardt Hanisch and revisiting the key sites on his journey, this powerful film traces Hitler's wilderness years in Vienna and Munich. Using rare archive film and new footage of his boyhood home we follow Hitler's descent from aspiring art student to homeless drifter living in a men's shelter in Vienna.

programme.title: The Crusade in the Pacific
programme.desc: When the Japanese navy bombs Alaska and occupies islands off its shores, the U.S. responds by air and by sea and forces them out.
programme.sub-title: War in the North: The Aleutians

programme.title: The Crusade in the Pacific
programme.desc: American Army and Marine forces land unopposed and meet little resistance as they split Okinawa in half. Later, as armies move north and south, fighting grows more fierce. In the southern half, stiff Japanese resistance and rain bog down offensive operations. In the end, the Battle of Okinawa proves costly for both sides.

programme.title: War in the Pacific
programme.desc: Tensions begin to rise in Korea.

programme.title: Battlezone WWII: America's Greatest Generals
programme.desc: A profile of General Dwight D. Eisenhower with a bonus program on General Joseph 'Vinegar Joe' Stilwell.
programme.sub-title: Dwight D. Eisenhower, Joseph 'Vinegar Joe' Stilwell

programme.title: WWII War Diaries
programme.desc: In this first film of the series, '1939', follow the prelude to war and consider how the Treaty of Versailles, drawn up after the First World War, failed to keep the peace. Watch the rise of Adolf Hitler and Nazi Germany and learn of those who attempted to stop his bid for global domination. See for yourself the preparations made by the people of Britain as war became inevitable.

programme.title: Heroes Never Die: The Miniseries
programme.desc: With English Closed Captions. In the New Terminal, the volunteer fighters argue, laugh, violate the commander's orders while defending the airport. programme.title: The Crusade in Europe

programme.title: The Big Attack: Combat Heroes of WWII
programme.desc: 'Tell it to the Chaplain' is a favorite expression of servicemen. This is the tale of a chaplain who, every Sunday, held services amidst ear-splitting gunfire in the fox holes. But when their officer was wounded, the men didn't need a Chaplain, they needed leadership to face oncoming Germans. This Chaplain didn't let his boys down, improving leadership, not taught at O.C.S., to repel the attack.

programme.title: The Crusade in Europe
programme.desc: On July 25th, 1943, Benito Mussolini is ousted from power. We then flashback to his rise to power, including the Fascist march on Rome in November, 1922. In 1936 Ethiopia is invaded. programme.title: Monsters and Mysteries
programme.desc: Much of inland California is remote wilderness. Within the Sierra Mountains, come legends of the Bigfoot Wars... and a terrifying Evil Gnome that stalks an innocent family. Further south, the legendary HellHound wreaks havoc in a desert neighborhood.
programme.sub-title: Bigfoot Wars, Evil Gnome, Hell Hound

programme.title: Monsters and Mysteries
programme.desc: Federal investigations involving a mysterious bigfoot from outer space; An aquatic mega monster viciously emerging from the depths; And a shape shifting werewolf summoned to protect the swamps. UFO Bigfoot, Lake Pepin Monster, Cajun Werewolf.
programme.sub-title: UFO Bigfoot, Lake Pepin Monster, Cajun Werewolf

programme.title: Monsters and Mysteries
programme.desc: A family's day hike turns to nightmare when the children run off on their own, only to encounter the monstrous Grassman. The Ohio River and the Big Muddy River in Illinois also harbor beasts: Green Clawed Beast and Big Muddy Monster.
programme.sub-title: Green-Clawed Beast, Big Muddy Monster, Grassman

programme.title: Monsters and Mysteries
programme.desc: In Columbus, Indiana a swampy beast's terrifying attacks lead to the largest monster hunt in U.S. history. Bizarre gel-like rain sickens residents in one town; could the military be to blame? And hungry Devil Dogs guard a cursed Wisconsin island.
programme.sub-title: Mill Race Monster, Toxic Rain, and Devil Dogs

programme.title: Alien Disclosure Files
programme.desc: Some places in the world, record more UAP sightings than the rest. So many so, in fact, that people flock from all over the world just for the chance to glimpse a flying saucer.

programme.title: Alien Disclosure Files
programme.desc: As the Fermi Paradox states, the possibilities that there is advanced life in the universe is surprisingly high. And if the universe is so old, why haven't we had any contact with extraterrestrial life?

programme.title: Alien Disclosure Files
programme.desc: In July of 2023, David Grusch, a former high ranking US Intelligence officer testified to a US government Oversight Committee that there are alien spacecraft located at secret facilities in the US.

programme.title: Alien Disclosure Files
programme.desc: UAPs have only recently been witnessed entering the ocean at very high speeds. And since our oceans can be as much as six miles deep, is it possible that some of these UAPs were simply trying to get home?

programme.title: Alien Disclosure Files
programme.desc: According to physics, time travel is possible. So could it be that UAPs aren't coming from somewhere else, but from some when else. Could these UAPs be us, from the future?

programme.title: Unsealed Alien Files
programme.desc: If aliens have visited Earth, why are they here and what are they truly after? Investigations have revealed the possibility that aliens are interested in experimenting on not only the human body, but the human mind as well.

programme.title: Unsealed Alien Files
programme.desc: In order to survive mankind must find a way to navigate the galaxy. Alien encounters have offered a possible glimpse into the secrets of interstellar flight, but how would extraterrestrials know how to navigate the vast regions of space?

programme.title: Unsealed Alien Files
programme.desc: Rapid advancements in science and technology have given mankind unprecedented access to distant galaxies that could harbor life. And some scientists believe that to find alien life we need look no further than our own backyard.

programme.title: Unsealed Alien Files
programme.desc: Examining the possibility that UFOs may be from Earth.

programme.title: Unsealed Alien Files
programme.desc: In 1947, a series of UFO sightings triggers an unprecedented analysis that propels the UFO phenomenon on to the world stage. We investigate how the U.S. Air Force comes to the stunning conclusion that UFOs may not be from Earth.

programme.title: Unsealed Alien Files
programme.desc: UFO sightings happen almost every day. But in the court of public opinion the most credible witnesses come from law enforcement. Join us as we investigate the most important police sightings of UFOs.

programme.title: Unsealed Alien Files
programme.desc: Between 1981 and 2011, NASA's Space Shuttles flew 135 missions. The Space Shuttle cameras, manned and unmanned, have recorded astounding footage of UFOs that many experts find almost impossible to explain.

programme.title: Ghost Dimension Flying Solo
programme.desc: Buried under the location Sean investigates tonight, is the bones of the deceased and it appears that they are at unrest. Will Sean solve the mystery of who is haunting this location?

programme.title: Ghost Dimension
programme.desc: Could a tattoo studio be haunted? Has a Ouija board opened a gateway to the spirit dimension? Ghost Dimension spend the night investigating Deviant Ink tattoo studio and come across some of the strangest paranormal activity that they have ever encountered.

programme.title: Ghost Dimension
programme.desc: The ghost dimension team visit Batley, West Yorkshire to investigate a location where it may not be the building that's haunted but the items that reside within. Currently used an an auction house, could it be a haunted object amongst the many hundreds that pass through here or is a former owner/employee of the building reluctant to move on even after the hammer has gone down.
programme.sub-title: Long Lost Treasure at Jessops Old Mill and Auction House

programme.title: Ghost Dimension Lockdown
programme.desc: Bex and Sean are joined by a special guest as they investigate an abandoned home full of spirits in Liverpool.
programme.sub-title: Soul Less House of Ghosts Part 1

programme.title: Paranormal Files: Extraordinary Stories - Ordinary People
programme.desc: On December 28, 1980, the Rendlesham Incident became a legendary mystery, as US Air Force soldiers recorded witness accounts of mysterious lights appearing in the skies of Suffolk, England.

programme.title: Paranormal Files: Extraordinary Stories - Ordinary People
programme.desc: For decades, Kent's Blue Bell Hill has been the site of mysterious phenomena. Rumored ghost sightings have haunted the pastoral site. Explore the haunting legacy of Blue Bell Hill in this episode.
programme.sub-title: The Mystery of Blue Bell Hill

programme.title: On the Yeti Trail
programme.desc: Does the Yeti really exist? Our film sets out to meet the teams involved in this strange race across the world, and features laboratories, hair analysis, footprints and DNA as well as the search for samples in Indonesia and in Canadian nature reserves. A fascinating and thorough film, featuring, amongst others, French Collège de France paleoanthropologist Pascal Picq.

programme.title: World's Greatest Mysteries
programme.desc: Bigfoot. Sasquatch. Yeti. Yeren.Yowie. There are reports the world over of these terrifying creatures. This program shows a chilling eyewitness encounter plus scientific analysis of the creature's footprints providing startling insights into this mystery.
programme.sub-title: Bigfoot: Living Creature or Legendary Lie?

programme.title: The Other Side: Secrets of the Paranormal World
programme.desc: Continuation of Exorcism but this time in Italy with Father Dermine, a Roman Catholic Exorcist. Discussion with Derren Brown and Matteo Borrini. Introduction to Simulation Theory and Psychics. Controlled Experiments and discussion with Derren Brown, Uri Geller and Peter Sage. A discussion between believer and non-believer.

programme.title: The Conspiracy Show with Richard Syrett
programme.desc: Richard travels to Mississippi to interview an expedition organizer who plans to lead a team to the Arctic aboard a Russian nuclear ice-breaker in search of an entrance into the interior of our world. A researcher and member of the planned expedition provides evidence that the earth, like all planets, was formed with a hollow core.
programme.sub-title: Journey to the Center of the Earth

programme.title: The Conspiracy Show with Richard Syrett
programme.desc: Richard examines the fable of the vampire and investigates the possibility that 'demonically reanimated corpses' may in fact exist. He travels to the United Kingdom to interview an Anglican Bishop who claims to have destroyed several vampires. He also gets the chance to interview a well known U.S Paranormal Investigator.

programme.title: The Conspiracy Show with Richard Syrett
programme.desc: Ouija Boards a Harmless board game or portal to the spirit world? Richard delves into the history and folklore of 'talking boards' with a collector of Ouija boards and a world renowned paranormal investigator. An L.A county police dispatcher shares several paranormal experiences she Connects to her use of an Ouija board.

programme.title: The Conspiracy Show with Richard Syrett
programme.desc: Richard speaks with victims of alleged electronic harassment, the supposed use of electronic devices to harass, torture, and/or physically harm a person. Some victims allege that the government is behind it. Richard also speaks with a private investigator who specializes in electronic counter measures and a social psychologist who dismisses such claims as fantasy and paranoia.

programme.title: The Conspiracy Show with Richard Syrett
programme.desc: Richard meets the owners of an abnormal humanoid skull allegedly discovered in Mexico in the 1930s and speaks with the researcher who conducted tests on the skull. Is it the skull of a badly deformed child? Is it a hoax? Is it the remains of an extraterrestrial? Is it a human-alien hybrid? A cranio-facial surgeon and a skeptic provide us with their perspectives on this very strange relic.

programme.title: EXtraterrestrials: They are Among Us
programme.desc: What can lead a military man to draw his service weapon in his own base, and completely unload the magazine of his rifle? In the cases that we are going to analyze, these military men claim to have witnessed the appearance of strange humanoid beings.

programme.title: EXtraterrestrials: They are Among Us
programme.desc: Explore mysterious sightings spanning millennia, from ancient rock art to recent encounters. Witness strange lights over Barranco de Badajoz and a peculiar being at 'El Condesito' farm in Huelva. Encounter enigmatic humanoids on Conil beaches. Hear from witnesses to unravel the uncanny connection between past depictions and present sightings.

programme.title: Unsealed Conspiracy Files
programme.desc: Unsealed: Conspiracy Files examines whether the United States government is preparing for a possible alien attack. It looks at a recent report of a joint naval mission by the U.S. and China to combat a hostile alien force over the Pacific Ocean.

programme.title: Unsealed Conspiracy Files
programme.desc: Unsealed: Conspiracy Files considers the theory that Adolph Hitler survived the end of the World War II. It looks at Operation Paperclip which allowed many Nazi scientists to come to the United States and considers Hitler possible escape to Argentina with assistance from the FBI. It also discusses continued Nazi influence in history.

programme.title: Unsealed Conspiracy Files
programme.desc: Unsealed: Conspiracy Files counts down the top ten secret societies: (10) The Hellfire Club, (9) The Majestic Twelve, (8) The Knights of the Golden Circle, (7) Opus Dei, (6) The Bohemian Club, (5) Skull and Bones, (4) The Bilderberg Group, (3) The Knights Templar, (2) The Freemasons, and (1) The Illuminati.

programme.title: Unsealed Conspiracy Files
programme.desc: Unsealed: Conspiracy Files looks at some of the secret government warehouses of the United States. It looks at Fort Knox gold depository and asks whether the gold there has been removed. It also examines Hangar 18 at Wright Patterson Air Force base in Ohio and whether it contains crashed alien craft or the Nazi Die Glocke.

programme.title: Unsealed Conspiracy Files
programme.desc: Unsealed: Conspiracy Files examines a conspiracy that may be seeking to eradicate 90% of the world's population. It looks at the Georgia Guidestones built by an unknown architect which call for humanity to reduce its population to below 500 million.

programme.title: Unsealed Conspiracy Files
programme.desc: Unsealed: Conspiracy Files examines whether the United State military has constructed flying saucers. It looks at unclassified documents describing Project 1794 and a supersonic large disk fighter aircraft. These plans are later developed by a Canadian company Avro Aircraft into the Avrocar.

programme.title: Alien Disclosure Files
programme.desc: From military radar to Navy aircraft, sightings of Unidentified Aerial Phenomena have become more frequent of late and been measured on ever more sophisticated technology. It has lead to unprecedented acceptance of alien contact across the globe, including by the US government. What could these visitors be after?
